messages:
Carmen (SRE): Follow-up from today's postmortem: need final status page language, confirm who fields gated-RCA requests, and assign owners for recurring-pattern remediation.

Jules (Ops): I can draft the public status page + 72h summary. Target: tom morning.

Diego (Product): Keep public wording non-technical. Add a single-line "impact" stat and a clear 'do I need to do anything' line.

Nina (Support): I'll collect the affected-customer list and prep outbound templates. Need final copy by tomorrow 2pm.

Carmen (SRE): Proposal: public short summary on status page; detailed RCA available on request to enterprise customers via support. Ops to gate requests and log them.

Diego (Product): Agree. Also propose a 5-business-day SLA to respond to RCA requests. Put that in the FAQ.

Jules (Ops) (status copy draft):
```
What happened
On Mar 23, a cache eviction regression caused a brief latency spike for a small subset of generation requests between 02:12 and 02:40 UTC.

Impact
Approximately 3% of requests experienced higher latency. No customer data exposure.

What we did
Reverted the configuration change and deployed a patch to the eviction heuristic. Weadded extra monitoring for cache churn.

Next steps
A summarized timeline will be posted here. Customers requiring a detailed technical RCA can request it via support; we will respond within 5 business days.
```

Carmen (SRE): Language tweaks: change "regression" -> "configuration change" and remove internal tool names. Add note: "we are running a systemic review of cache-related incidents".

Nina (Support): For gated-RCA requests: Ops triages, then escalate to solutions/sales for account-specific analysis. I'll post the request template to the tracker.

Jules (Ops): Owners & deadlines (proposed):
- Public status + 72h summary: Jules (Ops) - due: 1 business day
- Outbound messages for affected customers: Nina (Support) - due: tomorrow 2pm
- Fix + tests for eviction logic: Carmen (SRE) - due: 10 business days
- Systemic incident pattern review: Diego (Product) + Carmen (SRE) - schedule first session in 2 weeks

Diego (Product): Add task for evaluating default cache configs for Dedicated customers. Owner: Diego - due: 3 weeks.

postmortem-bot: Action items logged: PM-2090, PM-2091. Link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/PM-2090

Nina (Support): Affected-customer list shared via secure doc. Draft outbound message: "We experienced a brief latency spike on Mar 23 affecting some requests. We reverted the change and deployed a fix. No action required from you; weare monitoring for stability."

Jules (Ops): Quick edit: include "what this means for you: no action required" line.

Carmen (SRE): I'll update the postmortem tracker with PRs and ETA once the fix branch is open. Expect the gated RCA draft in ~7-10 days for review. Thanks all.
